name: An incompatible IrisValue header fails before payload allocation

input.source_text: module M { public fun run() -> Object { mut stream = %{}; stream["magic"] = "IRISVALUE"; stream["format_version"] = 2; IrisValue.decode(stream) } } M.run()

applicability.reason: C015 leaves the byte schema to the separately versioned format, so this observes the header, limit and eligibility rules the chapter does fix.
